Load.title: Load
Load.description: Represents a single trucking load, capturing details from pickup to delivery and its associated revenue.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Load entity.

loadNumber.description: Unique identifier for the load often provided by the broker or carrier.

brokerCarrier.description: The name of the broker or carrier associated with this load.

pickupDate.description: The date and time when the load was picked up.

deliveryDate.description: The date and time when the load was delivered.

originLocation.description: The origin city and state of the load (e.g., 'Chicago, IL').

destinationLocation.description: The destination city and state of the load (e.g., 'New York, NY').

billedMileage.description: The total mileage billed for this load.

ratePerMile.description: The rate charged per mile for this load, if applicable.

flatRate.description: A flat fee charged for the load, if not based on mileage.

grossRevenue.description: The total gross revenue generated by this load.

notes.description: Any additional notes or comments about the load.

status.description: The current status of the load (e.g., 'Booked', 'Picked Up', 'Delivered', 'Paid').

ExpenseCategory.title: ExpenseCategory
ExpenseCategory.description: Defines a category for expenses, allowing for better organization and reporting, and assisting AI categorization.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ExpenseCategory entity.

name.description: The name of the expense category (e.g., 'Fuel', 'Maintenance', 'Tolls').

description.description: A brief description of the expense category.

isDeductibleDefault.description: A boolean indicating if expenses in this category are typically tax-deductible by default.

Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: Represents a single incurred expense, such as fuel, maintenance, or tolls, which can be categorized and tracked.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Expense entity.

date.description: The date and time when the expense was incurred.

amount.description: The monetary amount of the expense.

description.description: A detailed description of the expense.

location.description: The city and state where the expense occurred (e.g., 'Chicago, IL').

categoryId.description: Reference to the ExpenseCategory this expense belongs to.

loadId.description: Optional reference to the Load entity this expense is assigned to for per-load calculation.

loadNumber.description: The load number associated with this expense for easy identification.

isRecurring.description: Indicates if this expense is part of a recurring payment.

isTaxDeductible.description: A boolean indicating if this specific expense is tax-deductible.

notes.description: Any additional notes about the expense.

PayPeriod.title: PayPeriod
PayPeriod.description: Summarizes financial data (earnings, expenses, deductions) for a specific user-defined pay period.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PayPeriod entity.

startDate.description: The start date and time of the pay period.

endDate.description: The end date and time of the pay period.

generatedDate.description: The date and time when this pay period summary was generated.

grossEarnings.description: The total gross earnings from loads within this pay period.

totalExpenses.description: The total amount of all expenses within this pay period.

totalDeductions.description: The total amount of specific deductions (e.g., non-expense related fees) for this pay period.

netPayEstimate.description: The estimated net pay for this pay period after expenses and deductions.

loadIds.description: An array of references to Load entities included in this specific pay period summary.

expenseIds.description: An array of references to Expense entities included in this specific pay period summary.

AppConfiguration.title: AppConfiguration
AppConfiguration.description: Stores global application settings and user preferences, such as pay period definition.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AppConfiguration entity. Expected to be a singleton (e.g., 'appConfig').

payPeriodStartDay.description: The day of the week on which a pay period typically starts (e.g., 'Monday').

payPeriodTimeZone.description: The time zone used for calculating pay periods (e.g., 'America/New_York').

defaultTaxRatePercent.description: A default percentage used for estimating tax deductions across pay periods.

defaultBrokerFeePercent.description: A default percentage used for estimating broker fee deductions.
